stimulus.text: Epidemic disease killed enormous numbers of Native people who had no immunity to European illnesses. The encomienda depended on Native workers, and disease destroyed that workforce. With Native labor collapsing, Spain turned to enslaved Africans, brought in under the asiento, the Crown's monopoly contract for supplying enslaved people to Spanish America. The demand for coerced labor never went away; what changed was who was forced to work.

parts.prompt: Identify one cause of the collapse of the Native workforce in Spanish America.
Explain one reason Spain turned to enslaved African labor.
Explain one way the shift from Native to African forced labor changed Spanish colonial society.

instruction: Answer each part in your own words from the stimulus only. Do not open the question file.
